skill.displayName: Vidu official video generation. Image to video / Text to video / Reference to video / Text to image / Reference to image / Video edit / Image edit
skill.summary: Generate video and images by calling the official Vidu API via vidu CLI. Use when the user wants text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, head-tail-imag...

latestVersion.changelog:
**Expanded input support for advanced video and audio generation; adds new cost queries.**

- Added support for `--video` and `--audio` inputs in `character2video` tasks with model 3.2_a (local files only; URLs not supported).
- Introduced new commands: `task tts-cost` and `task lip-sync-cost` to estimate credit used for TTS and lip-sync tasks.
- Updated input behavior and documentation for handling images, video, and audio, including input validation details.
- English documentation file renamed; added Chinese README (`README.zh.md`).
- Improved descriptions for supported model variants and advanced reference/video generation features.
